## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the **Bhaiṣajyaguru** practice — companion to Vajrabodhi's earlier [KR6j0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0093) in the Bhaiṣajyaguru ritual corpus. Recension A of two parallel recensions (T924A and T924B = [KR6j0094](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0094) and [KR6j0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0095)), both bearing the same title and attributed to Amoghavajra.

**Abstract**

The text gives Amoghavajra's codification of the Bhaiṣajyaguru *sādhana*, complementing Vajrabodhi's earlier version ([KR6j0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0093)) and establishing the canonical Tang Esoteric Bhaiṣajyaguru practice. The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Chángān period (746–774).
